title: thermocouple-its90: NIST ITS-90 thermocouple conversion for Python
description: Voltage to temperature and temperature to voltage for thermocouple types B, E, J, K, N, R, S and T on the ITS-90 scale, with cold-junction compensation and a test suite verifying all 12,026 tabulated NIST reference points. Includes a Model Context Protocol server for AI agents. The engine also powers the live calculator at https://dfieser.com/ThermocoupleConverter/index.html.
